name: Billing Services Amount 1
definition: Taxable service charge amount conversions to host currency.

HostAmount.name: Host Amount
HostAmount.definition: Sum of all the individual taxes on the service expressed in the host currency.

PricingAmount.name: Pricing Amount
PricingAmount.definition: Amount of the tax obligation expressed in the tax region's pricing currency.|Usage: This is the same amount as carried in the host amount but allows the sender to optionally express the value in the pricing currency.
